title: Software Development Trainee
description: Job Description Have you set the course for the future? We’ll give you the green light! Because at Frauscher, we always have our eyes firmly fixed on progress. Let’s embark on this journey together! Our agility and enthusiasm for new things are reflected in our innovative technologies and services – and, of course, also in our corporate culture. Join Frauscher now and start your career journey with the technology leader! At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. Our industry leading field elements, software, connectivity and data access solutions, combined with smart life cycle services, ensure system critical components are operational and provide the information rail operators need to maximise the safety, efficiency and capacity of their networks. We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being "Your partner for confidence." Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Software Development Trainee to join our software development team. The role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, working with technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Angular, and Rust. The candidate will work alongside experienced developers to develop, test, and maintain software applications while building practical engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and maintaining software applications. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code following established coding standards. Participate in software debugging, troubleshooting, and testing activities. Work with SQL databases and perform database operations and queries. Understand technical requirements and contribute to their implementation. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior developers. Collaborate with team members to complete assigned development tasks. Follow software development processes and continuously improve technical skills. Qualifications & Experience BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Systems. Candidates who graduated in 2025 and above are eligible to apply. Fresh graduates with 0–1 year of experience. Basic knowledge of at least one programming technology: Java, Kotlin, Angular, or Rust. Knowledge of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming concepts. Internship experience in software development is preferred. Training certification in any of the above technologies is an added advantage. Familiarity with Git and software development practices is preferred. Basic knowledge of working with AI-assisted software development tools is preferred. Strong motivation, willingness to learn, and passion for software development. Good analytical, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Strong team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and contribute positively to team goals. In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Are you bursting with curiosity and creativity? Do you have brilliant ideas and want to set the course for the future, today? If so, embark on your Frauscher journey with us! Additional Information What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First? At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. Who are we? Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. Culture powers us and the possibilities. We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more. Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

Wabtec has approximately 27,000 employees in facilities throughout the world. Whether your talents lie in digital solution development, next-gen manufacturing, advanced service delivery, or the spectrum of business functions that support them, Wabtec literally has a world of opportunity for you across our global network.

title: Management Trainee - Talent Acquisition
description: About Us Zycus is a global leader in Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation. At the core of Zycus’ platform is Merlin AI , an advanced AI-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real-time visibility and actionable insights. Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as Gartner, Forrester, and IDC for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long-term business value. With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement. We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer: Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements. Job Description We are looking for ambitious Engineering and MBA graduates to join our HR team as a Management Trainee – Talent Acquisition. This 6-month full-time program is designed for high-potential individuals eager to kickstart a career at the intersection of people, business, and technology. As a trainee, you will gain hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment, work closely with business leaders, and develop a strong understanding of hiring strategies in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment. This is a unique opportunity to build strategic, analytical, and stakeholder management skills that form the foundation of a successful career in HR and talent management. Note: This is a full-time internship role. Candidates should be willing to work full-time as a Management Trainee for 6 months with potential for full-time conversion based on performance. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Recruitment: Support the complete hiring lifecycle — sourcing, screening, coordination, and onboarding for non-technical roles Talent Sourcing: Proactively source candidates through job boards, social media, networking, and referrals Engaging Conversations: Conduct persuasive and sales-driven conversations with candidates, promoting Zycus as an employer of choice Candidate Management: Manage the recruitment pipeline, ensuring timely follow-ups and smooth candidate experiences Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with hiring managers and the TA team to align recruitment strategies with business needs Reporting & Analytics: Track recruitment metrics and provide insights to improve sourcing strategies and reduce time-to-hire Job Requirement Required Qualifications B.E/B.Tech/MBA from a reputed institute (mandatory) Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a persuasive, consultative approach High ownership mindset with excellent follow-up discipline Go-getter attitude with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong organizational and multitasking capabilities Willingness to commit to a 6-month full-time trainee program Preferred Skills MBA degree (optional but preferred) Prior internship or exposure in recruitment, HR, or sales Familiarity with recruitment tools and platforms Understanding of SaaS business models What You'll Gain Exposure to end-to-end recruitment in a global SaaS organization Direct collaboration with business leaders and hiring managers Development of stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills High-energy, performance-driven work culture Potential full-time conversion based on performance Experience with AI and advanced recruiting tech Why Join Zycus? Global Leader: One of only three Indian-origin product companies positioned as a Leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant, operating across 20+ global offices Industry Recognition: Recognized across Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Customers' Choice Strong Brand Momentum: Continuous global marketing investments with AI-led product innovation High-Impact Exposure: Work on business-critical positions that directly influences growth Innovation-Driven Culture: Fast-paced environment focused on measurable business outcomes
company_description:
Zycus, recognized by leading analyst firms in procurement technology, empowers teams to unlock deep value through its comprehensive Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions. At the heart of our S2P solution is the Merlin Agentic Platform, which orchestrates intelligent AI agents to deliver simplified, efficient, and compliant processes.
 
The Merlin Intake Agent offers business users unparalleled ease of use, increasing adoption rates and significantly reducing non-compliant spending. For procurement teams, the Merlin Autonomous Negotiation Agent handles tail spend autonomously, securing additional savings; the Merlin Contract Agent helps draft compliant contracts and reduces risks by actively monitoring them; and the Merlin AP Agent further enhances efficiency by automating invoice processing with exceptional speed and accuracy.

title: Graduate Apprenticeship Trainee - Helpdesk
description: Overview: Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology. This is a gateway to begin your professional journey with one of the world’s leading scientific instrumentation companies, committed to innovation, learning, and development. This structured 12-month program offers immersive learning experiences across various business functions, giving you real-time exposure to operations, technologies, and corporate dynamics. Responsibilities: In-depth working on Salesforce Service Max for case logging and management Vonage calls handling, following escalation procedures, and documentation Using remote diagnostic tools for initial issue identification Understanding log file analysis and system performance checks Shadowing experienced engineers during remote support sessions Learning how to guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Assisting customers with preventive maintenance tasks Engaging in advanced troubleshooting techniques Handling customer interactions and conflict resolution Contributing to the internal knowledge base and documentation. Gain hands-on experience with demo systems and software testing. Collaborating with field service engineers and other teams. Professional Growth: Learn from experienced mentors and industry leaders while working on live projects and tools. Skill Development: Sharpen your technical and analytical skills through structured training and on-the-job learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gain end-to-end business insights while working closely with diverse teams. Innovation Exposure: Be part of a company that empowers scientific discovery with cutting-edge solutions. Qualifications: Recent graduates (Bachelor’s) in Engineering in Electronics & communication, Instrumentation, Bachelor’s or Masters in Physics/Electronics/Instrumentation.

We are a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable our customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular and cellular levels. Many of our products are used to detect, measure and visualize structural characteristics of chemical, biological and industrial material samples.

In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy & Nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics, proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

At Burns & McDonnell, our engineers, construction professionals, architects, planners, technologists and scientists do more than plan, design and construct. With a mission unchanged since 1898 — make our clients successful — our more than 13,500 professionals partner with you on the toughest challenges, constantly working to make the world an amazing place.
